# Columns

One grid is one `.columns` div holding every cell row-major; `cols` says how many cells make a row.

::: {.columns gutter=1em cols=2}

::: {.column width=60%}

Intercepts: $20$ pasties on the vertical axis and $5$ cakes on the horizontal. The frontier is the line between them, $P = 20 - 4C$.
